article.title: Provisions of this Chapter generally applicable to summons and warrants of arrest
article.content:
93Provisions of this Chapter generally applicable to summons and warrants of arrest

Section 93 · Chapter VI · Other rules regarding processes
The provisions contained in this Chapter relating to summons and warrant, and their issue, service and execution, shall, so far as may be, apply to every summons and every warrant of arrest issued under this Sanhita.
